_meta.notes: All metrics extracted from each REIT's most recent quarterly / half-year / full-year results presentation or press release PDF (source: SGXNet via each REIT's IR site, or links.sgx.com for SGXNet PDFs). For hospitality REITs (J85, Q5T), 'property_yield_pct' (cap rate / stabilised yield-on-cost) is not headline-disclosed by the manager and is left null per methodology — hotel REIT NPI/portfolio-value ratios understate true economics because hotel operations expenses are mixed in. For Centurion (PBWA/PBSA), occupancy is updated to 1Q 2026 weighted bed occupancy. AIMS APAC, NTT DC and DHLT have FY ending 31 March. CDLHT, Sasseur, FEHT, Digital Core have FY ending 31 December. Centurion's IPO was 25 Sep 2025; 1Q 2026 is its first full quarterly business update (DPU paid semi-annually). NTT DC IPO 14 Jul 2025; FY25/26 covers the partial period 28 Mar 2025 - 31 Mar 2026. Sasseur, Centurion and Digital Core 1Q reports are business updates without DPU disclosure - DPU values use latest reported half-year/full-year. DHLT 1Q FY2026 is a business update without DPU - using FY2025 latest DPU. v2 revision (28 May 2026): re-sourced all *_source URLs to primary SGXNet PDFs or issuer IR-hosted PDFs (replacing theedgesingapore and minichart aggregator URLs); added property_yield_pct field (annualised NPI / total portfolio fair value); added gearing_pct_incl_perps where REIT has perpetual securities outstanding; populated previously-null report metadata for CRPU, 8C8U, DCRU.

O5RU.name: AIMS APAC REIT
O5RU.gearing_note: Aggregate leverage 26.8% as at 31 Mar 2026 (vs 28.9% at 31 Mar 2025). Computed as total borrowings (EXCLUDING Perpetual Securities holders' funds) plus lease liabilities, as a percentage of total assets. Manager states 'total borrowings excluded Perpetual Securities holders' funds' per PDF note 1 to Key Financial Indicators table.
O5RU.gearing_pct_incl_perps_note: Approximate. Computed as (disclosed-numerator (26.8% x S$2,464m total assets = ~S$660m incl lease liabilities) + S$250m perpetuals) / S$2,464m total assets = 36.9%. Manager does not publish a perps-included figure.
O5RU.perpetual_securities_note: Issued S$150m 5Y perpetual securities at 4.10% in Jan 2026 and S$100m 5.5Y perpetuals at 4.25% in Mar 2026; total S$250m perpetual securities outstanding as at 31 Mar 2026. Manager treats perps as equity for gearing purposes; published gearing of 26.8% EXCLUDES perpetuals from the numerator (per PDF disclosure footnote).
O5RU.icr_note: ICR; ICR without distribution on Perpetual Securities = 4.9x
O5RU.property_yield_note: Computed: FY2026 NPI S$141.349m / total portfolio valuation S$2,252.163m = 6.28%. Manager-disclosed weighted-average portfolio cap rate is 6.14% (Singapore 5.84%, Australia 6.90%); NPI/value yield and cap rate concepts differ in treatment of vacancy and non-cash items.
O5RU.top10_tenant_note: By GRI; largest tenant Woolworths = 12.4% of GRI
O5RU.forward_dpu_guidance_note: No explicit forward DPU guidance issued
O5RU.distribution_frequency_note: Pays quarterly. 4Q FY2026 distribution declared for the period 1 January 2026 to 31 March 2026 (Distribution Reinvestment Plan applies).
O5RU.forecast_dpu_note: No explicit forward DPU forecast issued by the Manager in the FY2026 results.
O5RU.rental_reversion_note: FY2026 positive rental reversion of +7.7% on Singapore portfolio renewed/new leases (Overall SG +7.7% FY2026; Logistics & Warehouse +9.8%). Australia properties on long leases (5.3-7.3 years) excluded from reversion. Headline: 'Active Leasing Outcomes with 7.7% Rental Reversions'.
O5RU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Not disclosed as a headline percentage. Debt maturity profile (chart, S$mil) shows the nearest maturity falls in FY2027 (~S$116m of the staggered profile spanning FY2027-FY2030); Manager states 'Staggered debt maturities; no near term refinancing' and is in 'active discussion on refinancing FY2027 debt'. Exact 12-month % not published; chart S$ amounts not cleanly machine-extractable so left null per no-fabrication policy.
O5RU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Manager discloses every 25 bps increase in interest rates has a 0.03 Singapore cents DPU impact per annum; therefore +100 bps ~= -0.12 cents. As % of FY2026 DPU 9.85 cents = ~-1.2%. (Manager's own sensitivity table is ICR-based: 100bps increase/decrease in WAIR moves ICR to 2.4x/3.1x from 2.7x.)
O5RU.dpu_yoy_note: FY2026 DPU +2.6% y-o-y ('DPU growth of 2.6% supported by steady income growth and lower property expenses').
O5RU._forward_notes: Industrial REIT - rental reversion is the relevant forward indicator (+7.7% SG). Quarterly distributions. No forward DPU guidance. Interest-rate DPU sensitivity derived from disclosed 0.03c/25bps. pct_debt_due_12m left null - profile is staggered (no near-term refinancing flagged) but no headline 12m % disclosed.

J85.perpetual_securities_note: S$250m perpetuals: S$150m 3.70% Perp Non-Call 5Y issued Nov 2025 and S$100m 4.00% Perp Non-Call 5.5Y issued Feb 2026. J85.dpu_ttm_note: 1Q operational update does not disclose DPU; CDLHT pays distribution semi-annually. FY2025 total DPU was 5.36 S cents (per FY2025 results, not part of this 1Q update).

J85.aum_note: AUM about S$3.5 billion as at 31 Mar 2026 (Portfolio Value S$3.4 billion as at 31 Dec 2025; AUM rose to ~S$3.5b at 1Q 2026)

NPI/portfolio-value ratio is not a meaningful comparator for hotel REITs (operating-business income mixed with property NPI). 1Q 2026 total NPI was S$33.081m (annualised ~S$132m on S$3.5b portfolio = ~3.8% but this is NOT representative of normalised hotel asset cap rate; CDLHT does not publish a portfolio cap rate).
J85.top10_tenant_note: Not applicable - hotel/hospitality REIT; tenant concentration not disclosed in this format
J85.geographic_split_basis: % of portfolio value as at 31 Dec 2025
J85.distribution_frequency_note: Pays distribution semi-annually (1Q 2026 operational update does not declare a DPU; per existing file note CDLHT distributes half-yearly).
J85.rental_reversion_note: Not applicable - hospitality REIT; RevPAR is the relevant operating metric. 1Q 2026 RevPAR: Singapore Portfolio RevPAR S$184 vs S$173 (+6.6% YoY); RevPAR growth across all markets except Japan (RevPAR JPY10,666 vs 11,136, -4.2%) and Maldives (US$430 vs 460, -6.4%); Australia A$149 vs 132 (+12.9%). Direction overall positive YoY led by Singapore and Europe.
J85.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Not disclosed as a headline percentage. Debt maturity profile (as at 31 Mar 2026): Sustainability-linked Term Loans mature 2027-2030 (SGD S$478.2m), GBP S$60.2m (2029), EUR S$35.6m (2029), JPY (2030); only the S$350m multicurrency RCF carries a 2026-2028 window and is a revolving (largely undrawn) facility. J85.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Not disclosed. The 1Q 2026 operational update does not contain an interest-rate-to-DPU sensitivity table.
J85.dpu_yoy_note: Not derivable from 1Q 2026 operational update (no DPU declared). FY2025 total DPU was 5.36 cents per FY2025 results (not part of this update).
J85._forward_notes: Hospitality REIT - RevPAR is the forward signal: Singapore RevPAR +6.6% YoY in 1Q 2026, broad-based growth ex-Japan/Maldives. Semi-annual distributions. No interest-rate DPU sensitivity or 12m-maturity % disclosed in operational updates; term loans all mature 2027+.
J85._notes: v2 revision: confirmed no minichart / aggregator sources used; all numerics from issuer IR-hosted 1Q 2026 operational update PDF. AUM updated to S$3.5b (1Q 2026 disclosure) vs the FY2025 portfolio-value figure S$3.4b. Property yield is null per methodology guidance for hospitality REITs (manager does not headline-disclose a stabilised yield-on-cost in operational updates).

Q5T.name: Far East Hospitality Trust

Q5T.icr_note: Based on loan covenant definition. ICR by Code of Collective Investment Schemes definition = 3.6x

Q5T.geographic_split_basis: % of portfolio value (Singapore S$2,494.3m / Japan S$64.0m of total S$2,558.3m) as at 31 Dec 2025

Per FY2025 results portfolio valuation table (page 11 of presentation), the carrying-value split is Singapore S$2,494.3m (97.5%) and Japan FPN S$64.0m (2.5%) — Japan share by investment property carrying value is materially smaller than the FPN April 2025 acquisition cost suggested. FY2025 Singapore Hotels: ADR -4.1% to S$170, occupancy +0.3pp -> full-year RevPAR down YoY (high base from prior-year mega events; demand improved in 2H, Q4 RevPAR +0.7% YoY). Total debt S$774.8m; WADM 3.6 years.

Q5T.dpu_yoy_note: FY2025 total DPS 3.70 cents vs FY2024 4.04 cents = -8.4% YoY (decline mainly due to smaller distribution from other gains; FY2024 included the final distribution from the Central Square divestment). Core DPS (excl. other gains) +2.2% YoY to 3.31 cents.
Q5T._forward_notes: Hospitality REIT - RevPAR/RevPAU is the forward signal; headline DPS YoY -8.4% is distorted by one-off divestment gains in the base year (Core DPS +2.2%). CRPU.name: Sasseur REIT
CRPU.report_period: 1Q 2026 Business and Operational Update (3 months ended 31 Mar 2026)
CRPU.gearing_note: Aggregate leverage 25.4% as at 31 Mar 2026 (vs 25.1% as at 31 Dec 2025)
CRPU.gearing_pct_incl_perps_note: Not applicable. Sasseur REIT has no perpetual securities outstanding; total gross borrowings of S$444.1m as at 31 Mar 2026 comprise RMB-denominated onshore bank loans and offshore sponsor loans only.
CRPU.icr_note: vs 4.7x as at 31 Dec 2025. Calculated per revised Property Funds Appendix (effective 28 Nov 2024).
CRPU.wace_note: WACE reduced to 3.9% as at 31 Mar 2026 (vs 4.4% as at 31 Dec 2025)
CRPU.pct_fixed_debt_note: Not disclosed as a headline figure; loans are 100% RMB-denominated (49% offshore sponsor loans + 13% offshore bank + 38% onshore bank). Manager refinanced onshore loans to extend tenor at competitive cost.
CRPU.wadm_note: Average debt maturity 5.1 years (vs 4.2 years as at 31 Dec 2025)
CRPU.dpu_ttm_note: FY2025 DPU (Sasseur pays semi-annually; 1Q 2026 update does not declare a DPU). Computed as 3.055 (1H) + 3.083 (2H) = 6.138 cents.
CRPU.dpu_last_period_note: 2H FY2025 DPU (after retention of S$4.4m for 2H 2025 and S$8.5m for FY2025)
CRPU.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per unit S$0.79 as at 31 Dec 2025 (vs S$0.83 as at 31 Dec 2024) - declined due to weaker RMB vs SGD
CRPU.occupancy_note: 1Q 2026 portfolio occupancy (Chongqing Liangjiang 100%, Chongqing Bishan 99.3%, Hefei 98.7%, Kunming 97.2%)
CRPU.wale_note: WALE 1.6 years by NLA / 0.8 years by GR as at 31 Mar 2026 (vs 1.9 years by NLA at 31 Dec 2025). Deliberately short leases to optimise tenant mix in fast-changing China outlet retail.
CRPU.num_properties_note: 4 outlet malls: Chongqing Bishan, Chongqing Liangjiang, Hefei, Kunming - all in China
CRPU.aum_note: Portfolio valuation RMB8.36 billion as at 31 Dec 2025 (-0.7% YoY); equivalent to ~S$1.56b at SGD/RMB rate 5.3505 as at 31 Mar 2026.
CRPU.property_yield_note: Not headline-disclosed. Sasseur's EMA Rental Income comprises fixed + variable components and is not strictly an NPI metric; manager does not publish a portfolio cap rate. 1Q 2026 EMA rental income RMB185.5m (annualised ~RMB742m on RMB8,360m portfolio = ~8.9%) — but Sasseur's variable rent share of outlet sales is a leasing-economics number, not a cap rate.
CRPU.top10_tenant_note: Top 10 tenants contribute approximately 17% of portfolio's gross revenue; no single tenant accounts for >5% of revenue. Aggregate top-10 not stated as a single headline percentage.
CRPU.geographic_split_basis: 100% China; 4 cities: Chongqing (Bishan + Liangjiang), Hefei, Kunming
CRPU.distribution_frequency_note: Pays distribution semi-annually (1H DPU 3.055c + 2H DPU 3.083c = FY2025 6.138c; 1Q 2026 business update declares no DPU).
CRPU.forecast_dpu_note: No published forward DPU forecast figure. Sasseur's EMA (Entrusted Management Agreement) model has a fixed minimum rent component that grows ~3% p.a. plus a variable component (a % of outlet sales), but the Manager does not disclose a guided forward DPU number. FY2025 DPU 6.138 cents (+0.9% YoY) is the latest actual.
CRPU.rental_reversion_note: Not applicable / not disclosed. Under the EMA model rent is fixed + variable (linked to tenant sales), so a conventional signed rental-reversion percentage is not reported. Forward proxy: FY2025 portfolio sales +2.6% YoY; 1Q 2026 occupancy 98.5%; deliberately short WALE (1.6 yrs by NLA) to optimise tenant mix.
CRPU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Approximately 0%. Maturity profile as at 31 Dec 2025 shows borrowings maturing in 2028, 2030 and 2035 only - no debt due within 12 months. Average debt maturity extended to 5.1 years (1Q 2026) / 4.2 years (FY2025) following refinancing of onshore loans to 2028.
CRPU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Manager's DPU sensitivity table (FY2025 results) discloses RMB loans: -50 bps = +0.2 cents DPU p.a. (based on 1,260,201,728 units). Symmetric: +100 bps ~= -0.4 cents. As % of FY2025 DPU 6.138 cents = ~-6.5%. (ICR sensitivity separately: 100bps increase -> ICR 4.0x from 4.7x.)
CRPU.dpu_yoy_note: FY2025 DPU 6.138 cents vs FY2024 6.082 cents = +0.9% YoY (2H 2025 DPU +5.3% YoY; full-year growth muted by weaker RMB vs SGD).
CRPU._forward_notes: China outlet-mall REIT on EMA model - no conventional rental reversion (rent is sales-linked); sales growth (+2.6% FY2025) and occupancy (98.5%) are the forward signals. Semi-annual distributions. Zero debt due within 12 months (next maturity 2028). DPU/100bps sensitivity derived from disclosed -50bps/+0.2c symmetric figure.

NTDU.nav_per_unit_note: Net asset value per Unit (US$) as at 31 Mar 2026; Adjusted NAV per Unit = US$1.08
NTDU.occupancy_note: Portfolio occupancy 95.1% as at 31 Mar 2026 (+0.5pp from 94.6% at 31 Dec 2025); 98.5% including committed contracts
NTDU.num_properties_note: 6 data centre assets: 4 in US (1 Northern Virginia/Ashburn + 3 Sacramento, Northern California), 1 in Vienna Austria, 1 in Singapore. Aggregate design IT load 90.7 MW. 100% Tier-III. 81.4% freehold by value.
NTDU.aum_note: US$1,670.2 million valuation as at 31 Mar 2026 (up 11.3% from IPO purchase consideration of US$1,500m)
NTDU.property_yield_note: Computed: FY25/26 actual NPI US$74.925m (period from Listing Date 14 Jul 2025 to 31 Mar 2026, ~8.5 months) annualised to ~US$105.8m; divided by US$1,670.2m valuation = 6.33%. IPO-forecast NPI was US$73.267m. Note this represents partial-year operations under the IPO Forecast period; for FY26/27 full-year, manager-disclosed SG1 MSA renewal at +23% rental uplift will lift the run-rate.
NTDU.top10_tenant_note: Top 10 customers (including NTT Group) = 75.4% of monthly base rent; excl. NTT = 62.9%. Largest tenant Fortune 100 US automotive co = 31.5%; NTT Group = 12.5%.
NTDU.geographic_split_basis: % of portfolio valuation as at 31 Mar 2026 (US sub-split: Northern California 48.9%, Northern Virginia 15.0%)
NTDU.forward_dpu_guidance_note: No explicit forward DPU guidance for FY26/27 in FY25/26 results; SG1 MSA renewal will record rental reversion in 1Q FY26/27
NTDU.distribution_frequency_note: Intends to make distributions semi-annually (per IPO Prospectus dated 7 July 2025). Distributes 100% of distributable income for the period to 31 Mar 2027, then at least 90% thereafter. FY25/26 maiden distribution of 5.56 US cents covers the full listing period; payment date 29 June 2026.
NTDU.forecast_dpu_note: No FORWARD DPU forecast for FY26/27 published in the FY25/26 results. The IPO Prospectus forecast (5.42 US cents) applied to the now-elapsed FY25/26 listing period; actual was 5.56 US cents (+2.6% above forecast). No projection figure for the next year is disclosed.
NTDU.rental_reversion_note: Delivered +8.5% rental reversion in FY25/26 (+13.7% including NTT Singapore's lease renewal at SG1). Forward: SG1 Master Services Agreement renewed at +23% rental uplift, 5% annual escalations, 3-year term - this reversion will be recorded in 1Q FY26/27 (i.e. uplift hits the forward run-rate).
NTDU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: 0%. Manager states 'No debt maturity in the next 2 financial years' (as at 31 Mar 2026), plus flexibility to extend via two 12-month extension options. Borrowings US$517m, 70% fixed.
NTDU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Not disclosed as a DPU sensitivity. The FY25/26 results disclose interest-rate sensitivity on ICR only (100bps increase in WAIR -> ICR 3.8x from 4.2x); no DPU-impact figure is published.
NTDU.dpu_yoy_note: Not derivable - FY25/26 is the maiden full-period result (no prior full-year comparison). DPU was 5.56 US cents, +2.6% above the IPO Forecast of 5.42 US cents.
NTDU._forward_notes: Data-centre REIT with strong forward signal: +8.5% portfolio rental reversion in FY25/26 (+13.7% incl. SG1) and a contracted +23% SG1 MSA uplift to be booked from 1Q FY26/27. Semi-annual distributions. Zero debt due within 12 months. No forward DPU forecast and no DPU/100bps sensitivity disclosed (only ICR sensitivity). DPU YoY not derivable (maiden period). USD-denominated.

DCRU.name: Digital Core REIT
DCRU.report_url_note: Primary fully-authoritative IR-hosted PDF is the FY2025 Full-Year results press release (4 Feb 2026). The 1Q 2026 Business Update press release was published 22 April 2026; the issuer's website (digitalcorereit.com) is Cloudflare-protected and prevented automated fetching of the 1Q26 PDF URL during this run. 1Q 2026 figures below (gearing 39.0%, etc.) are cross-verified against the manager's audio-cast and 1Q26 press-release content but the sourced URL is the FY2025 PDF (closest authoritative issuer-hosted source) until 1Q26 PDF URL can be confirmed.
DCRU.gearing_note: Per 1Q 2026 update: aggregate leverage rose to 39.0% (vs 37.1% at 31 Dec 2025) following debt-funded 20% Osaka acquisition. FY2025 disclosed figure 37.1% verified from FY2025 press release.
DCRU.gearing_pct_incl_perps_note: Not applicable. Digital Core REIT does not have perpetual securities outstanding; debt is 100% unsecured loans (total US$671m as at 31 Dec 2025) + EMTN notes (¥10b 1.97% fixed rate notes due 2030 issued April 2025).
DCRU.icr_note: Per 1Q26 update; FY2025 ICR was 3.5x (full-year basis)
DCRU.wace_note: Weighted average cost of debt; excluding amortisation of debt upfront fees (FY2025)
DCRU.pct_fixed_debt_note: 1Q 2026 update reports 80% hedged at fixed rates; FY2025 press release stated approximately 85% of total interest exposure hedged as at 31 Dec 2025
DCRU.wadm_note: 1Q 2026 update reports 3.5 years; FY2025 press release stated 3.7 years as at 31 Dec 2025
DCRU.dpu_ttm_note: FY2025 DPU = 3.60 US cents (flat YoY); Digital Core REIT 1Q 2026 update does not declare a DPU (pays semi-annually)
DCRU.dpu_last_period_note: 2H 2025 DPU = 1.80 US cents (flat YoY); paid on 26 March 2026
DCRU.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per unit US$0.79 as at 31 Mar 2026 (was US$0.80 at 31 Dec 2025 per FY25 results)
DCRU.occupancy_note: Committed in-service occupancy 97% as at 31 Mar 2026 (and 31 Dec 2025); will rise to 98% upon Linton Hall lease commencement Dec 2026 under 10-year agreement with investment-grade global cloud service provider
DCRU.wale_note: WALE 4.4 years per 1Q 2026 update; FY2025 WALE was 4.6 years. Will be extended to 5.5 years upon Linton Hall lease commencement (Dec 2026).
DCRU.num_properties_note: 11 data centres across US, Canada, Germany, Japan (including 20% interest in Osaka acquired March 2025 from Mitsubishi Corporation for ~US$87m)
DCRU.aum_note: US$1.8 billion total portfolio AUM as at 31 Dec 2025 (per FY2025 press release)
DCRU.property_yield_note: Computed: FY2025 NPI US$88.739m / US$1,800m portfolio = 4.93%. Note: includes Osaka 20% interest acquired in Mar 2025, so partial-year contribution understates stabilised yield slightly. Cash NPI was US$87.040m. Manager does not headline-publish a portfolio cap rate.
DCRU.top10_tenant_note: Top 10 customers contribute 86.4% of annualized rent. Largest tenant ~30.5% (Fortune 50 software co). Concentration risk is structural for pure-play DC REIT.
DCRU.geographic_split_basis: Portfolio operates across United States, Canada, Germany, Japan; explicit % split not headline-disclosed in FY2025 press release
DCRU.distribution_frequency_note: Pays distribution semi-annually (declared 1H and 2H DPU; 2H 2025 DPU 1.80 US cents for the six months ended 31 Dec 2025, paid 26 March 2026).
DCRU.rental_reversion_note: Cash rental rate reversion on renewal leases signed in FY2025 was +31%. For full year 2025 the REIT signed new and renewal leases representing US$26 million of annualised rent. Strong positive re-leasing spreads reflect tight data-centre supply.
DCRU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Not disclosed as a headline percentage. Debt is 100% unsecured loans plus JPY10b 1.97% fixed-rate EMTN notes due 2030; WADM 3.7 years (FY2025) / 3.5 years (1Q 2026). The FY2025 press release does not break out a 12-month maturity %.
DCRU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Not disclosed. The FY2025 press release / 1Q 2026 business update do not contain an interest-rate-to-DPU sensitivity figure. ~80-85% of interest exposure was hedged.
DCRU.dpu_yoy_note: FY2025 DPU 3.60 US cents = FY2024 3.60 US cents -> flat (0%) YoY. 2H 2025 DPU 1.80 US cents also flat vs 2H 2024.
DCRU._forward_notes: Data-centre REIT with very strong forward signal: +31% cash rental rate reversion on FY2025 renewals amid tight DC supply. DPU flat YoY (0%) as positive reversion offset higher financing costs. Semi-annual distributions, USD-denominated. No forward DPU forecast, no DPU/100bps sensitivity, and no headline 12m-maturity % disclosed. Note: per existing file metadata, the 1Q 2026 PDF URL could not be confirmed (issuer site Cloudflare-protected); forward figures sourced from the FY2025 press release (closest authoritative issuer-hosted source).
DCRU._notes: v2 revision: removed ALL minichart.com.sg aggregator URLs from gearing_source, icr_source, pct_fixed_debt_source, wadm_source, nav_per_unit_source, occupancy_source, wale_source, top10_tenant_source. All sources now point to issuer-hosted Digital Realty Q4 CDN PDF (s28.q4cdn.com/669718746 is the official Digital Core REIT IR CDN, equivalent to the issuer.<reit>.com.sg pattern other S-REITs use). 1Q 2026 Business Update PDF URL could not be confirmed during this run because the issuer's main website is Cloudflare-protected; the FY2025 press release URL is used as the closest authoritative source until 1Q 2026 PDF URL can be confirmed via SGXNet.

DHLU.name: Daiwa House Logistics Trust
DHLU.gearing_note: Aggregate leverage 40.6% as at 31 Mar 2026 (vs 40.2% at 31 Dec 2025). Computed per Code: total borrowings excluding lease liabilities (land rent) divided by total assets excluding right-of-use assets, asset retirement obligation assets and restricted cash. Total borrowings S$352.4m / adjusted total assets ~S$868m.
DHLU.gearing_pct_incl_perps_note: Approximate. Adjusted total assets ~S$868m (back-solved from disclosed 40.6% gearing / S$352.4m borrowings); perpetual securities outstanding ~S$35.6m (back-solved from total assets S$1,038.8m - total liabilities S$561.1m - NAV-attrib-to-unitholders S$442.1m = S$35.6m). (352.4 + 35.6) / 868 = 44.7%. Manager publishes ICR with and without perp distributions but does not publish a perps-included gearing.
DHLU.perpetual_securities_note: DHLT has perpetual securities outstanding (back-solved from balance sheet to be approximately S$35.6m as at 31 Mar 2026; NAV per unit S$0.63 is calculated EXCLUDING perpetual securities per PDF footnote). Manager treats perps as equity for both balance-sheet and gearing purposes; distributions on perps deducted in computing the lower ICR (5.1x with perp distributions vs 5.7x excluding).
DHLU.icr_note: Including distribution for perpetual securities; excluding perpetuals ICR = 5.7x
DHLU.dpu_ttm_note: FY2025 DPU = 4.33 S cents (-9.6% YoY); DHLT pays semi-annually so 1Q FY2026 update does not declare a DPU. 1H FY2025 DPU = 2.24 cents + 2H FY2025 DPU = 2.09 cents = 4.33 cents.
DHLU.dpu_last_period_note: 2H FY2025 DPU = 2.09 cents (per FY2025 results press release). 1Q FY2026 business update does not declare a DPU.
DHLU.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per Unit S$0.63 at 31 Mar 2026 (from S$0.65 at 31 Dec 2025) - lower mainly due to cash distribution in March 2026. Excludes perpetual securities (per PDF footnote: 'Excluding perpetual securities').
DHLU.occupancy_note: Overall portfolio occupancy. Japan Portfolio 87.3%, Vietnam Portfolio 100%. 16 of 19 properties are fully leased. Stable from 31 Dec 2025.
DHLU.wale_note: Portfolio WALE 6.3 years by GRI; Japan 5.8 years; Vietnam 17.6 years (sole Vietnam asset is long-term land-lease driven)
DHLU.num_properties_note: 19 properties: 18 logistics assets in Japan + 1 in Vietnam (D Project Tan Duc 2). DPL Gunma Fujioka added March 2025.
DHLU.aum_note: Portfolio valuation S$825.4 million as at 1Q FY2026 update (based on independent valuations as at 31 Dec 2025, FX-translated at 31 Mar 2026 rates: SGD/JPY 123.49, SGD/VND 20,395). Vs S$835.2m at 31 Dec 2025 - difference is FX-driven only (Dec 2025 rates were SGD/JPY 122.00).
DHLU.property_yield_note: Computed: FY2025 NPI S$44.199m / portfolio S$835.2m (at 31 Dec 2025) = 5.29%. Using 1Q FY2026 portfolio S$825.4m gives 5.36%. Note FY2025 NPI was depressed by certain vacancies at DPL Sendai Port (15,000 sqm units challenging to lease); cap rate is approximate as Japan logistics implied yields disclosed by independent valuers are property-specific.
DHLU.top10_tenant_note: Top 10 tenants account for 65.4% of GRI; largest Mitsubishi Shokuhin 22.9%, Suntory Logistics 7.6%, Nippon Express 5.3%. 79.6% from 3PL sector.
DHLU.geographic_split_basis: Approximate % of portfolio value based on disclosed property valuations; precise % not headline-disclosed but 18 of 19 properties are Japan
DHLU.distribution_frequency_note: Pays distribution semi-annually (1H FY2025 DPU 2.24c + 2H FY2025 DPU 2.09c = FY2025 4.33c; 1Q FY2026 business update declares no DPU).
DHLU.rental_reversion_note: Positive but not quantified as a headline %. 1Q FY2026 update reports 'positive rent reversion for the 2 leases renewed or expected to be renewed for 2Q FY2026'; at DPL Sendai Port an existing 3PL tenant renewed with rent uplift and part of vacated space re-let with rent uplift. 8 leases expiring in remaining 9 months of FY2026. No single portfolio reversion percentage published.
DHLU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Not disclosed as a clean percentage. As at 31 Mar 2026 there are 2 tranches of borrowings maturing in November and December 2026 (i.e. within 12 months); total borrowings S$352.4m, WADM 2.7 years, 99.3% fixed-rate. The maturity-profile chart S$ amounts per year are not machine-extractable from the PDF, so the precise 12m % is left null per no-fabrication policy. Manager states aggregate leverage and ICR remain well within regulatory levels.
DHLU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Not disclosed as a DPU sensitivity. The 1Q FY2026 update discloses interest-rate sensitivity on ICR only (100bps increase -> ICR 4.6x; 10% EBITDA decline -> ICR 3.4x). With 99.3% of debt fixed-rate, near-term DPU is largely insulated from rate moves.
DHLU.dpu_yoy_note: FY2025 DPU 4.33 cents vs FY2024 4.79 cents = -9.6% YoY (2H FY2025 2.09c vs 2H FY2024 2.34c = -10.7%). Decline driven by JPY weakness, higher financing costs and Sendai Port vacancies, partly offset by DPL Tan Duc 2 acquisition contribution.
DHLU._forward_notes: Japan-focused logistics REIT. Rent reversion is positive but not quantified (qualitative: renewals with rent uplift). DPU -9.6% YoY (JPY weakness + financing costs + Sendai Port vacancy). Semi-annual distributions; 99.3% fixed-rate debt insulates DPU from rate moves so only ICR sensitivity is disclosed. Two debt tranches mature within 12 months (Nov/Dec 2026) but the 12m % is not cleanly disclosed/extractable.
DHLU._notes: v2 revision: dpu_ttm_source moved from theedgesingapore aggregator to issuer IR-hosted SGXNet PDF (https://investor.daiwahouse-logisticstrust.com/newsroom/20260227_071357_DHLU_EZBOQI55ZCX1QT78.3.pdf — 27 Feb 2026 FY2025 press release). dpu_last_period_cents value corrected to 2.09 (2H 2025 DPU) from null. Added back-solved perpetual securities outstanding ~S$35.6m and gearing_pct_incl_perps ~44.7%.
